findings.evidence: `WithLp p (α × β)` is a `NormedSpace 𝕜` from `[NormedSpace 𝕜 α] [NormedSpace 𝕜 β]` alone (`instance instProdNormedSpace [NormedField 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 α] [NormedSpace 𝕜 β]`, Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Lp/ProdLp.lean:995), and `instProdNormedAddCommGroup` needs only normed groups (ibid. line 721) — which is why `upperHalfSpace` (line 68) and the `ChartedSpace` instance (line 91) already compile under `[NormedAddCommGroup E]` alone. `riemannianMetricVectorSpace` is the only consumer of the inner product: `variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]` at Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Riemannian/Basic.lean:95.
findings.fix: Change line 141 to `variable (E) [NormedSpace ℝ E]` and insert `variable [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]` immediately before `euclideanMetric` (line 174), keeping `euclideanMetric`, `riemannianMetric`, the bundle instances, `inner_def`, `similarity` and `isPretransitive_isom` under the inner-product hypothesis.
findings.issue: `variable (E) [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]` is introduced before the manifold/smoothness material, which never uses the inner product: the `IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, WithLp 2 (E × ℝ)) ω (HyperbolicSpace E)` instance (line 143), `contMDiff_coe` (149), `mfderiv_coe_apply` (156), `contMDiff_inv_height_sq` (165), and the private similarity machinery `contMDiff_of_contMDiff_coe_comp` (234), `tangentSpaceCastModel_mfderiv_apply` (243), `similarityMap` and its lemmas (261-305) all need only a norm and a real scalar action on `E`. The inner product is first needed at `euclideanMetric` (174), which calls `riemannianMetricVectorSpace`. `InnerProductSpace ℝ E` is strictly stronger (`class InnerProductSpace ... extends NormedSpace 𝕜 E`, Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Defs.lean:109), so e.g. `HyperbolicSpace E` has a `ChartedSpace` but no usable `IsManifold`/`mfderiv` for a merely normed `E`.

summary: The construction sits at the right level in the base space (arbitrary real inner product space E, with ℍⁿ/ℍ³ as instances) and `conformal` is stated at Mathlib's general vector-bundle level. One too-strong hypothesis: the manifold and smoothness part of UpperHalfSpace.lean is placed under `[InnerProductSpace ℝ E]` where `[NormedSpace ℝ E]` suffices.
